title: Block-by-Block Performance Accounting in Group Room Blocks
content:
Group Room Blocks are never combined for performance. Pickup, complimentary room nights, attrition and cancellation damages are computed for each block on its own, from the attendee reservations that name that block's reference number.

**Authority of the record.** Pickup is counted only from reservations that name the block being assessed; rooms booked under another block of the same organiser, under a transient rate plan, or under no block at all never count, even at the same hotel on the same nights. Which block a reservation picks up is read from the reservation record itself, before any assessment is made, and the block being assessed is the block identified by its reference number.

**Money stays with its block.** A deposit, credit or payment of one block is never applied to another block's master account.

### Which reservations count toward the block being assessed

| Reservation | Counts toward the block being assessed |
|---|---|
| Names the block being assessed | Yes, under the block's pickup count |
| Names another block of the same organiser | Never |
| Booked under a transient rate plan | Never |
| Names no block at all | Never |
| Any of the last three, at the same hotel on the same nights | Never |

### Examples (hypothetical organiser holding two blocks)

An organiser holds block A and block B at one hotel on overlapping nights. Block A's attrition and complimentary rooms are computed only from reservations naming block A; a reservation naming block B adds nothing to block A, however short block A falls. A deposit received on block B is never applied to block A's master account, and a complimentary credit earned by block A is never credited to block B.
